title: I have been experimenting with cut outs. They work Great!
author: StrongLegStrongMan
selftext:
I have started working with cut out's. I ask the AI to make me cut out models I can place in blender. 2D pictures that you could add slits to and make a 3D model. I have stuff on my twitter here: [https://x.com/Jonatha20313374](https://x.com/Jonatha20313374)

I got myself in the game and I am pretty excited to use my own image as the main character. My twitter has a really good example picture to give to ChatGPT to get your starting place. I used MCP, Astra and Blender. [https://x.com/Jonatha20313374/status/2119600655920955776](https://x.com/Jonatha20313374/status/2119600655920955776)
